_about: Presenter scenarios (prompt Part 14.2, run sheet review/06-demo-and-qa.md a3). demo.scenario {id} resets to the preset, applies the tweaks (or, with from_fixture, builds that checkpoint through the same internal actions the UI path runs) and returns {route, role, staff, client, steps}. The presenter dock and the QA harness read this table. login: how the dock signs in (staffId by default). clock: the beat's place in the 14-minute walkthrough. message: what the audience should conclude (prompt Part 14.2). fixture: the checkpoint demo.scenario can reload in about ten seconds if a beat fails. Steps are click paths, one action each; a person presses Process Form, Get Signature and Send.

scenarios.title: Direct staff daily documentation
steps: Sign in as Kayla Hale (direct support)
Select M.R. on the phone
Say what happened, or use the example
Review the draft against the ISP objectives, then Looks right
Open M.R. in the mock Lauris and the daily note: 1 dictation waiting
Open What Psyflo added and check each source
Fill the open form (yellow boxes) and confirm the units
A person presses Process Form
My Work shows 5 of 6 daily notes in
scenarios.message: PsyFlo reduces documentation friction without removing staff judgment.

scenarios.title: School referral through intake
steps: School counselor submits the referral (REF-118)
Clinician reviews it and sends the family link (simulated text)
Guardian fills the five steps on the phone
Eligibility shows details received; a person records the check
Screening call starts in Lauris: create the consumer, open Admission screening
Missing questions show in the panel; play the scripted call
Stop: the draft waits for the clinician; a person presses Process Form
Intake opens with the answers carried forward (CNA: copied from screening)
scenarios.message: Information is captured once and reused appropriately.

scenarios.title: Initial authorization
steps: Review the treatment plan (checkpoint: plan ready)
Open the initial request draft in the panel
Trace each statement to its source chip
Edit criterion 1; Fill all 7 boxes
A person presses Process Form, then the approver approves internally
A licensed person presses Get Signature in Forms to Approve
A person presses Send (simulated Sfax receipt)
Authorizations shows Submitted with the decision clock
scenarios.message: Documentation, signatures, submission and tracking form one connected workflow.

scenarios.title: Continued-stay evidence
steps: Open M.R.'s continued-stay request (Evidence review)
Pick the evidence period
Review the daily notes counted from stored records
Review guardian and collateral contacts
Check intervention counts and dates
Exclude what should stay out
Read the Evidence missing list
Fill the yellow boxes for the clinician to review (do not process)
scenarios.message: The system reduces repetitive chart review without inventing evidence.

scenarios.title: Payer decision
steps: Open the partial offer for D.W. (Partial: decide)
Open it in Denial Intelligence: evidence and valid options
Peer-to-peer preparation for T.N.; schedule the call
Record the decision with its document reference
Back to the authorization: status and units updated
scenarios.message: The clinic does not lose continuity when a payer decision requires further work.

scenarios.title: Leadership view
steps: Sign in as Dana Owens (administrator)
Open Analytics: Pilot scorecard
Payer performance; a payer row opens Denial Intelligence
Patient population (illustrative cohort banner)
Drill down as a clinician, own caseload only
Export a report with the period and dataset in the file
